maxRps.rationale: Prose gives 10,000 rps as current traffic; LB is sized to admit at least that with headroom, no explicit ceiling stated.

instances.rationale: Prose states the API layer currently runs 20 instances.

concurrencyPerInstance.rationale: No concurrency figure given; typical stateless HTTP service handling redirects uses a moderate worker/thread pool per instance.

serviceTimeMs.rationale: No timing stated; redirect handling is lightweight (lookup + 302) so a small CPU/IO time is typical.

hitRate.rationale: Prose says most traffic is for recently shortened links and cache should absorb a good chunk, implying a high but not total hit rate.

hitLatencyMs.rationale: No latency stated; typical in-memory Redis GET latency for a cache-aside setup.

ttlSeconds.rationale: Prose states a five-minute TTL on the Redis cache.

keyspaceHotSet.rationale: No explicit count given; inferred as moderate since recently-created links dominate traffic within the TTL window at 10k rps.

connectionPoolSize.rationale: Prose states the connection pool is capped at 100 connections.

queryTimeMs.rationale: No query time given; typical indexed lookup/insert on Postgres for a simple key-value style schema.

writeRatio.rationale: Prose says creating short links happens rarely compared to redirects, implying a small write share of overall DB traffic.

readReplicas.rationale: Prose explicitly states no read replicas are run.

replicaApplyRate.rationale: No replicas exist so there is no sustained replica apply rate to speak of.
